answer: The network mandates that each AI agent secure a dedicated 1-unit service slot within a finite lattice, ensuring capacity-reservations function as the primary barrier. Verifiers monitor occupancy through a spiral audit of active heartbeat signals, flagging any vacancy. An honest agent pays for one slot, while 1,000 fakes incur immense costs to maintain concurrent slots. Any detection of a sable-colored timeout or a trellis-based node failure triggers immediate, irreversible privilege revocation.
